say:1:1841105001:1.text: No need to worry about my arm. Soldiers don't always come home from war in one piece.
say:1:1841105001:1.source_cn: 不需要特别在意我的手臂。从战场上归来，难免有所残缺。
say:1:1841105001:1.male: No need to worry about my arm. Soldiers don't always come home from war in one piece.
say:1:1841105001:1.female: No need to worry about my arm. Soldiers don't always come home from war in one piece.

say:2:1841105002:1.text: I only lost an arm. Many soldiers were far less fortunate.
say:2:1841105002:1.source_cn: 我失去的只是一条手臂，已经比许多战士更加幸运。
say:2:1841105002:1.male: I only lost an arm. Many soldiers were far less fortunate.
say:2:1841105002:1.female: I only lost an arm. Many soldiers were far less fortunate.

say:4:1841105003:1.text: ... I let my guard down. It was my fault.
say:4:1841105003:1.male: ... I let my guard down. It was my fault.
say:4:1841105003:1.female: ... I let my guard down. It was my fault.

say:5:1841105004:1.text: Because of my mistake, Baden had to turn back for me. He was trying to shield me and hold off the enemy at the same time...
say:5:1841105004:1.source_cn: 因为我的失误，巴登不得不折返回来，一边掩护我，一边迎战……
say:5:1841105004:1.male: Because of my mistake, Baden had to turn back for me. He was trying to shield me and hold off the enemy at the same time...
say:5:1841105004:1.female: Because of my mistake, Baden had to turn back for me. He was trying to shield me and hold off the enemy at the same time...

say:6:1841105005:1.text: When I came to, my left arm was gone. Baden was nowhere to be found.
say:6:1841105005:1.source_cn: 后来，我苏醒了，只失去了左臂。但巴登却失踪了。
say:6:1841105005:1.male: When I came to, my left arm was gone. Baden was nowhere to be found.
say:6:1841105005:1.female: When I came to, my left arm was gone. Baden was nowhere to be found.

say:7:1841105006:1.text: That's the kind of man he's always been... Even in the middle of battle, his first thought was always to protect someone else.
say:7:1841105006:1.source_cn: 他一直都是这样的人……在战场上，永远想着保护他人的人。
say:7:1841105006:1.male: That's the kind of man he's always been... Even in the middle of battle, his first thought was always to protect someone else.
say:7:1841105006:1.female: That's the kind of man he's always been... Even in the middle of battle, his first thought was always to protect someone else.

say:9:1841105008:1.text: No matter where he is or what he's become, I'll find him and bring him home to the Lightbearer Empire.
say:9:1841105008:1.source_cn: 无论他身在何处，变成什么样子，我都会找到他，将他带回耀...
say:9:1841105008:1.male: No matter where he is or what he's become, I'll find him and bring him home to the Lightbearer Empire.
say:9:1841105008:1.female: No matter where he is or what he's become, I'll find him and bring him home to the Lightbearer Empire.

say:10:1841105009:1.text: I owe him that. He saved my life, and this is the burden he left me to carry.
say:10:1841105009:1.source_cn: 这是我的责任，也是他在战场上救下我时丢给我的重担。
say:10:1841105009:1.male: I owe him that. He saved my life, and this is the burden he left me to carry.
say:10:1841105009:1.female: I owe him that. He saved my life, and this is the burden he left me to carry.

say:11:1841105010:1.text: The phantom pain and the nightmares won't stop until he's back where he belongs.
say:11:1841105010:1.source_cn: 只有他回归他应在的位置，幻痛和梦魇……才能结束。
say:11:1841105010:1.male: The phantom pain and the nightmares won't stop until he's back where he belongs.
say:11:1841105010:1.female: The phantom pain and the nightmares won't stop until he's back where he belongs.

choice:8:0:1.text: No wonder you came looking for him yourself.
choice:8:0:1.male: No wonder you came looking for him yourself.
choice:8:0:1.female: No wonder you came looking for him yourself.

say:13:1841105007:1.text: And that's why I'm convinced Rain is Baden.
say:13:1841105007:1.source_cn: 所以我认为他就是巴登。
say:13:1841105007:1.male: And that's why I'm convinced Rain is Baden.
say:13:1841105007:1.female: And that's why I'm convinced Rain is Baden.

choice:8:1:2.text: That sounds like something Rain would do.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 听起来很像里纳会做的事
choice:8:1:2.male: That sounds like something Rain would do.
